name: Finny: AI Money Manager
price_of_comparable_item: Finny Pro $3.49 and $24.99 (App Store in-app purchases; billing period not labelled, likely month/year); Pro Family $10.49 / $74.99; core manual tracking free; no student price listed
what_it_sells: AI expense tracker: log by typing, speaking or scanning receipts; says it never asks for a bank login; receipt scan is Pro

name: Monarch
price_of_comparable_item: Core $14.99/mo or $99.99/yr; Plus $199.99/yr; no student discount listed
what_it_sells: Bank-synced budgeting, net worth, AI Assistant; receipt scanning since Dec 2025 attaches a receipt photo to the matching bank transaction and splits it by category
positioning_line: Your home base for money clarity

name: Cleo
price_of_comparable_item: Plus $5.99/mo; Pro $8.99/mo; Builder $14.99/mo (Cleo page returned 403; prices from https://toolradar.com/tools/cleo-ai/pricing, 'last confirmed on Nov 11, 2026'); no yearly or student price found
what_it_sells: AI money chat, budgeting, credit builder and cash advances; bank connected via Plaid
positioning_line: Credit Builder & Savings Goals (App Store subtitle; site blocked)

name: YNAB
price_of_comparable_item: $14.99/mo or $109/yr; college students get one free year with proof of enrolment (https://www.ynab.com/college), not renewable
what_it_sells: Zero-based budgeting; bank import for select banks or file import; photos and memos on transactions
positioning_line: Save $600 in one month, $6,000 in one year

name: Rocket Money
price_of_comparable_item: Premium: pay what you want on a sliding scale (App Store lists Premium in-app purchases from $2.99 to $9.99); Premium+ fixed $15/mo; 7-day trial; no student price
what_it_sells: Subscription finder and cancellation, bill tracking, budgets, bill negotiation; works from linked accounts
positioning_line: The money app that works for you.

name: Copilot Money
location_or_channel: iPhone, iPad, Mac, web; no Android listed
price_of_comparable_item: $9/mo or $109/yr on the website; App Store in-app purchases show $18 monthly and $109 yearly; no student price
what_it_sells: Bank-synced spending, budgets, investments, net worth
positioning_line: Your money finally has a copilot.

name: Goodbudget
price_of_comparable_item: Premium $10/mo or $80/yr; Free: 10 envelopes, 1 account, 2 devices, 1 year history; bank sync only on Premium; no student price
what_it_sells: Envelope budgeting; manual entry free, automatic bank sync paid (US banks)

name: Yomio Budget & Expense Tracker
what_it_sells: Receipt scanner that extracts items and prices into a budget
positioning_line: Scan receipts, manage budget (App Store subtitle)

name: Notion (with Notion AI)
price_of_comparable_item: Plus $10/member/mo (yearly billing saves up to 20%); Plus free for students with a school email; Notion AI is a limited trial on Free and Plus, full on Business $20
what_it_sells: Blocks, databases and templates the user builds into a life OS; AI agent on Business
positioning_line: One tool to run your company.

name: AnyList
what_it_sells: Shared grocery lists, recipes, meal plans
positioning_line: One app for stress-free shopping, cooking, and meal planning.

name: Bring!

positioning_line: The easiest shopping list to share

name: Todoist
